title: Oil at $100, a Fed hike & Nvidia's $6T chase

questions.text: The Fed released minutes this week from its September 15–16 meeting. What did the FOMC decide at that meeting?
questions.explanation: In a unanimous vote the Fed raised rates to 3.75–4.00%, its first hike since 2023, citing above-target inflation and Middle East tensions.

questions.text: With the war involving Iran still disrupting supply, where did Brent crude trade for most of this week?
questions.explanation: Brent spent the week around $102–108 and ended Friday near $102, more than 60% higher than a year ago.

questions.text: How many jobs did the US economy add in September, according to the latest payrolls report?
questions.explanation: Payrolls rose just 29,000 against an 84,000 forecast, and unemployment ticked up to 4.2% (133,000 was August's revised figure).

questions.text: France's Schneider Electric agreed this week to its biggest-ever acquisition, a roughly $22.6bn all-cash deal for which US industrial software maker?
questions.explanation: Schneider is paying $205 per share for PTC, a 42% premium; Schneider's shares fell about 7–8% on the news while PTC jumped around 35%.

questions.text: Nvidia hit fresh record highs this week. It is closing in on becoming the first company ever worth how much?
questions.explanation: Nvidia's value topped $5.8 trillion on Oct 6 after it expanded its buyback by $150 billion; it was already the first to reach $5 trillion, in October 2025.

questions.text: Bitcoin slid about 4% toward $80,000 on Thursday. Traders were nervous ahead of the one-year anniversary of which event?
options: The approval of US spot bitcoin ETFs
questions.explanation: The drop came days before the anniversary of the October 10, 2025 flash crash, with rising oil prices and rate-hike fears adding pressure.

questions.text: Kuaishou has reportedly hired banks for a Hong Kong IPO of at least $1bn for which of its businesses?
questions.explanation: Kling is Kuaishou's AI video-generation business; Ernie (Baidu), Doubao (ByteDance) and Qwen (Alibaba) belong to rivals.

questions.text: Memory-chip maker Micron, whose blowout results helped lift chip stocks, reported record fiscal-2026 revenue of roughly how much?
questions.explanation: Micron's fiscal-2026 revenue reached $133.2 billion, up from $37.4 billion a year earlier, on surging AI demand for memory.

questions.text: Jio Platforms reportedly set a price band for what could be India's largest-ever IPO. Which listing would it overtake for that title?
questions.explanation: At about ₹30,000 crore, Jio's IPO (subscription from Oct 21) would surpass Hyundai Motor India's roughly ₹27,870 crore listing in 2024.

questions.text: After emergency drawdowns, the US Strategic Petroleum Reserve fell to about 283 million barrels this week, its lowest level since…?
questions.explanation: The SPR hit its lowest level since 1982 as the Energy Department sought bids for the final 40 million barrels of a 172-million-barrel release.
